home.heroSubtitle: Servidores de quienes tienen necesidad y de los invisibles
home.missionText: Nuestra misión en LindaBen Foundation es proporcionar alimentos nutritivos, promover el bienestar, reducir el desperdicio de alimentos y ofrecer educación nutricional para ayudar a los niños y empoderar a sus familias a superar la inseguridad alimentaria y mejorar su salud.
home.visionText: Imaginamos un mundo donde ningún niño o familia pase hambre y donde todos tengan acceso a alimentos saludables y recursos que cambian vidas. A través de alianzas comunitarias, educación y cuidado compasivo, buscamos transformar los sistemas alimentarios locales y crear un cambio positivo duradero.
home.programsDescription: Brindamos servicios a poblaciones vulnerables y en riesgo en Maryland.
home.helpEyebrow: Cuida de tus hermanos y hermanas
home.donateHelp: Donar en línea nunca ha sido tan seguro, cómodo y sencillo. También aceptamos efectivo, cheques y donaciones en especie.
home.volunteerHelp: Participa hoy como voluntario. Tu ayuda mejora la vida de personas que enfrentan inseguridad alimentaria.
home.subscribeHelp: Suscríbete a nuestro boletín para recibir noticias, eventos y artículos sobre inseguridad alimentaria.
home.equalOpportunity: LindaBen es un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y está comprometido con la diversidad, equidad, igualdad, inclusión y justicia.
home.aboutText1: LindaBen Foundation ofrece soluciones innovadoras para fortalecer la seguridad alimentaria, reducir el desperdicio de alimentos y abordar desigualdades de salud.
home.aboutText2: A través del alcance comunitario y las alianzas, aumentamos nuestra capacidad para mejorar la calidad de vida de muchas personas.
home.donationText: Tu generosidad nos permite mejorar las condiciones de las personas y familias a las que servimos. Cada dólar marca una diferencia real.

programs.metaDescription: Transformer des vies grâce à des programmes compatissants, de Food as Medicine au bénévolat jeunesse.
programs.introTitle: Transformer des vies grâce à des programmes compatissants
programs.intro: Les programmes de LindaBen Foundation soutiennent et renforcent la communauté en offrant des services essentiels aux enfants et familles dans le besoin.
descriptions: Food as Medicine offre éducation nutritionnelle, intervention et accès à des produits frais pour des choix plus sains.
Notre garde-manger communautaire fournit une aide alimentaire et un accès à des aliments sains aux familles vulnérables.
Le centre de ressources offre des services complets aux parents et enfants vulnérables pendant les périodes difficiles.
Les jeunes bénévoles contribuent à lutter contre la faim des enfants et l’itinérance dans leurs communautés.
Nous relions personnes et organisations pour partager ressources, aide et inspiration.
Nous collaborons avec des programmes comme Capital Area Food Bank et Blessings in a Backpack pour fournir aliments, fournitures et services.

foodAsMedicine.title: Alimentation comme médecine
foodAsMedicine.metaDescription: Transform meals into healing moments with our Food as Medicine program. Free nutritious food boxes designed to meet unique nutritional needs.
foodAsMedicine.eyebrow1: Nourishing Families, One Box at a Time
blocks: Each family receives two boxes filled with fresh fruits, vegetables, eggs, pantry staples like pasta kits, oils, seasonings, ready-to-eat meals, rice, beans, and flour. When available, premium meat and fish are also included.
We adapt our offerings based on your budget and capacity. By listening to your feedback, we create food options that are culturally sensitive and meet the unique needs of your community.
We prioritize organic, regionally sourced produce, ensuring high-quality food while supporting local farmers and promoting sustainability.
Each box includes a bilingual guide with cooking tips, nutritional information, and life-skills to encourage healthier lifestyle choices for students and families.
foodAsMedicine.eyebrow2: Eat Well, Feel Better, Live Fully
foodAsMedicine.sectionTitle2: Fuel Your Body with Nature’s Best
foodAsMedicine.sectionText2: Our Food as Medicine (FAM) Rx Program is designed to transform meals into healing moments. Tailored to meet unique nutritional needs, this program ensures every bite counts, helping you feel better and live fully.
foodAsMedicine.locationsValue: Bryant Woods, Blue Heron Ln, Columbia, MD
foodAsMedicine.supportedByValue: Howard County Innovation Grant, MyVeggieVan.org, MikeandMelCruiseIn.com, St. Francis Fulton, HCPSS, LHIC, and more.
foodAsMedicine.signupAlt: Sign up for Food as Medicine program

resourceCenter.title: Nouveau centre de soutien communautaire
resourceCenter.metaDescription: Our innovative Community Resource Support Center addresses food insecurity and social determinants of health through personalized emergency assistance and educational programs.
paragraphs: The LindaBen Foundation is excited to announce the opening of our new Community Resource Support Center. This innovative program addresses food insecurity and social determinants of health in underserved communities by providing supplemental emergency food and community-based support.

Our new location serves as a hub where individuals and families can make appointments to receive emergency food assistance tailored to their availability. The center also offers information on community resources, events, and workshops.
Ending hunger requires more than providing food; it involves educating and uplifting the community. Our Resource Center offers access to nutrition education, cooking classes, and health workshops.
cards: Emergency Food Assistance
Scheduled appointments for personalized support.
Resource Hub
Access to information on local events, workshops, and community resources.
Access to Educational Programs
Nutrition education, gardening opportunities, cooking classes, and health workshops to promote healthy living.

youthVolunteerism.title: Bénévolat jeunesse
youthVolunteerism.metaDescription: Empowering the next generation of change-makers. Join our youth volunteers in fighting childhood hunger and homelessness in local communities.
youthVolunteerism.heading: Join a Movement of Change-makers
paragraphs: At the LindaBen Foundation, youth volunteers are on an important mission to make a positive difference by fighting childhood hunger and homelessness in schools and local areas.
Our volunteers are crucial to our summer programs and other activities. We invite you to create lasting solutions that benefit both land and marine environments.
cards: Make a Difference
Volunteering offers you the unique opportunity to directly contribute to alleviating hunger and improving community well-being.
Build Your Skills
Engage in diverse roles from food rescue to social media advocacy, enhancing your skill set while making meaningful contributions.
Create Impactful Connections
Meet like-minded individuals, weaving a network of people dedicated to fostering growth and advancing communal well-being.

communityOutreach.title: Sensibilisation communautaire
communityOutreach.metaDescription: Uniting hands and hearts in service. Join our network of over 30 organizations working together to end childhood hunger and homelessness.
communityOutreach.eyebrow: Uniting Hands and Hearts in Service
communityOutreach.heading: Lend Your Voice to a Cause That Echoes Through Communities
paragraphs: Our partnership with local and nonprofit agencies has been pivotal, allowing us to join forces with over 30 organizations. Our common goal is to motivate the wider community to engage actively in ending childhood hunger and homelessness.
We invite you to join our cause. Your participation helps us build a strong network to offer essential aid to those in urgent need.

partnershipsPrograms.title: Partenariats
partnershipsPrograms.metaDescription: Building stronger communities through strategic partnerships. Learn about our collaborations with organizations like Capital Area Food Bank and Blessings in a Backpack.
partnershipsPrograms.heading: Building Bridges for Better Communities
paragraphs: LindaBen Foundation partners with programs to provide food, supplies, and services to vulnerable communities, including Capital Area Food Bank and Blessings in a Backpack.
Through strategic partnerships and collaborative efforts, we multiply our impact and extend our reach to serve more families in need throughout Maryland and beyond.
cards: Blessings in a Backpack
Providing weekend food programs for elementary school children who may not have access to adequate nutrition over the weekend.
Capital Area Food Bank
Supporting our Community Pantry with fresh produce, pantry staples, and nutritious food items for families experiencing food insecurity.
Greater Riverdale Cares
Collaborating on community outreach initiatives and resource sharing to better serve families in the Greater Riverdale area.

communityPantry.title: Garde-manger communautaire
communityPantry.metaDescription: Addressing hunger head-on through our Community Pantry program. Serving over 850 households monthly with fresh food and essential resources.
communityPantry.heading: Nourishing Our Community
paragraphs: In the United States, hunger remains a pressing concern, with approximately one in six children at risk due to recent economic pressures. Many households are purchasing less expensive, often less nutritious food to stretch their budgets further.
At LindaBen Foundation, we respond to these challenges through direct intervention and support methods linked to community resources.
communityPantry.impactText: With partners including Capital Area Food Bank, Whole Foods, Costco, Amazon, Passion & Compassion, and public-school systems in Howard and Prince George’s County, our community pantries serve an average of 30,000 lbs of food monthly, supporting over 850 households and feeding around 3,000 individuals every month.

volunteer.title: Bénévolat et inscriptions
volunteer.quote: What good is it, my brothers and sisters, if someone claims to have faith but has no deeds? Show me your faith without deeds, and I will show you my faith by my deeds.
sections: We currently have a high need for drivers to pick up food donations and messages for families who are unable to visit our pantry. We prepare for difficult scenarios and coordinate delivery support.
LindaBen seeks like-minded individuals to help provide momentum that creates change in the local community. If you can volunteer your time, let us know how you can help.
Already volunteering or working with us? Use our online form to log volunteer hours for review, approval, and school or organization credit.
Join the LindaBen Foundation volunteer community.

aboutUs.title: À propos
aboutUs.metaDescription: Learn about LindaBen Foundation's mission to be a channel of safe haven for the homeless, at-risk population and underserved community.
aboutUs.heroText: LindaBen Foundation provides Child and Family Stability Services, affordable housing support, sustainable healthy food access, wraparound services, and pathways toward self-sufficiency for local communities and families in transition.
aboutUs.missionText: To be a channel of safe haven for the homeless, at-risk population and underserved community by uplifting their conditions and providing wraparound services founded in love and friendship.
aboutUs.visionText: To empower those in need and invisible by providing means to improve their quality of life in a community where they feel worthy, safe and accepted.
aboutUs.historyText: LindaBen Foundation was created in memory and honor of Anna S. Beavan’s parents, Linda Santos and Ben Dimatangal, and for people who died homeless or suffered in poverty, depression, mental health illness, and addiction.
leadershipTexts: Successful leadership begins with a sincere desire to serve for the benefit of others and steward the cause.
Our board members and volunteers play crucial roles in improving lives and carrying forth our mission.

history.title: Notre histoire
history.metaDescription: Learn about the founding story of LindaBen Foundation, from a personal journey of faith and compassion to a mission serving those in need.
history.quote: I have learned the secret of being content in any and every situation, whether well fed or hungry or in want. I can do all this through Him who gives me strength.
history.messageTitle: A Personal Message From Anna Beavan (Dimatangal), Founder & President
paragraphs: At a young age, Anna Beavan encountered stories of second chances that shaped her faith and compassion. After losing her mother, she found a renewed perspective and a seed of purpose that kept growing.

Years later, through family experiences, service with homeless outreach, and renewed faith, the idea of a foundation became clearer. LindaBen Foundation was born from love, remembrance, and the desire to uplift lives that had been cast aside.
The loss of her father and the hardships revealed through his life removed any remaining doubt about the kind of foundation she wanted to build.
When 2020 brought uncertainty and suffering, Anna chose to move forward in faith, believing more helping hands and kind hearts were needed to serve the homeless and those in need.
